title: Add Hierarchical Pathfinding (HPA*) to AStarGrid2D

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Closes godotengine/godot-proposals#14671

Adds an optional Hierarchical Pathfinding A* (HPA*) mode to `AStarGrid2D`, following the approach described in [this research](https://alexmelenchon.github.io/Hierarchial-Pathfinding-Research/).
Co-Autored by @Uauses


## How it works

When `hpa_enabled` is `true`, the grid is divided into square clusters of `hpa_cluster_size` cells. Walkable borders between adjacent clusters become *entrances*, which are sampled into transition nodes connected by inter-cluster edges; nodes inside the same cluster are connected by intra-cluster edges weighted with a bounded low-level A* search. Path queries then run A* on this much smaller abstract graph and refine each leg into concrete cells with a cluster-bounded A*.

The abstract graph is built lazily on the first path query and cached. It is invalidated (and rebuilt on the next query) when the grid is updated, solid cells change, or the cluster size changes; `update_hpa()` allows paying the build cost up front, and `is_hpa_dirty()` exposes the invalidation state. Disabling HPA* frees the graph's memory. 

## Public API

- `hpa_enabled` (bool, default `false`)
- `hpa_cluster_size` (int, default `5`)
- `update_hpa()`
- `is_hpa_dirty()`

## Performance

Benchmark on a 256 x 256 maze, cluster size 16, 300 queries: **2.40x faster** (738.54 ms -> 308.29 ms), with paths averaging 102.2% of optimal length. The speedup grows with the number of queries, as the one-time graph build is amortized.

HPA* trades a small amount of path quality for query speed, which is why it is opt-in and off by default. This way, existing projects are unaffected.

## Tests and docs

- Adds `tests/core/math/test_a_star_grid_2d.cpp` covering: path validity and near-optimality on open grids, reachability agreement with regular A* around obstacles, identical start/goal, walled-off goals, graph invalidation when solid cells change, toggling HPA* on/off, and `get_point_path`/`get_id_path` consistency.
- Updates the `AStarGrid2D` class reference for all new members and methods.
